## AI speedup?

To investigate the effect of AI on user productivity, researchers conducted a randomized experiment with 16 experienced software developers. The authors specified 246 different software development tasks, and randomly assigned each task to be completed with or without AI. The tasks were then divided between the different developers, and the researchers recorded the time it took to complete each task.

Each row in the data represents one task. We will work with the following variables:

* `dev_id`: unique ID for each developer
* `predicted_time_no_ai`: How long the developer estimated the issue would take *without* AI (minutes)
* `ai_treatment`: 0 if AI use was not allowed, 1 if AI use was allowed
* `initial_implementation_time`: Time taken by the developer to solve the issue and create an initial pull request (an initial solution) (minutes)

```{r, include=F}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(HLMdiag)
library(patchwork)

metr_ai <- read_csv("https://cmustatistics.github.io/data-repository/data/metr-ai.csv")
```

\newpage


# Model 1

$$\text{T}_{ij} = (\beta_0 + a_i) + (\beta_1 + b_i) \text{AI}_{ij} + \beta_2 \text{EstTimeNoAI}_{ij} + \varepsilon_{ij}$$

$$\varepsilon_{ij} \sim N(0, \sigma_{\varepsilon}^2) \hspace{0.5cm} \begin{bmatrix} a_i \\ b_i \end{bmatrix} \sim N\left( \begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ 0 \end{bmatrix}, \begin{bmatrix} \sigma_a^2 & \rho_{ab} \sigma_a \sigma_b \\ \rho_{ab} \sigma_a \sigma_b & \sigma_b^2 \end{bmatrix} \right)$$

where $\text{T}_{ij}$ is the initial completion time for developer $i$ on task $j$, $\text{AI}_{ij}$ is 1 if AI use was allowed on the task, and $\text{EstTimeNoAI}_{ij}$ is the developer's guess for the time it would take to complete the task without AI (the guesses were made before being assigned the tasks).

```{r, include=F}
m1 <- lmer(initial_implementation_time ~ 
             ai_treatment + predicted_time_no_ai +
             (ai_treatment|dev_id), data = metr_ai)
```


```{r, eval=F}
m1 <- lmer(initial_implementation_time ~ 
             ai_treatment + predicted_time_no_ai +
             (ai_treatment|dev_id), data = metr_ai)

summary(m1)
```

```
Random effects:
 Groups   Name         Variance Std.Dev. Corr 
 dev_id   (Intercept)  1205.2   34.72         
          ai_treatment  352.9   18.79    -0.19
 Residual              5692.8   75.45         
Number of obs: 246, groups:  dev_id, 16

Fixed effects:
                      Estimate Std. Error t value
(Intercept)          -18.57734   13.96529  -1.330
ai_treatment          17.36730   11.13830   1.559
predicted_time_no_ai   1.05437    0.07498  14.062
```

```{r echo=F, message=F, warning=F, fig.width=10, fig.height = 6}
set.seed(3)

m1_resids <- hlm_resid(m1, standardize = T)
m1_ranef <- hlm_resid(m1, level = "dev_id")


p1 <- m1_resids |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(dev_id),
             y = .std.ls.resid)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Developer ID", y = "Residuals (noise term)")

p2 <- m1_resids |>
  ggplot(aes(x = ifelse(ai_treatment == 0, "No", "Yes"),
             y = .std.ls.resid)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "AI use?", y = "Residuals (noise term)")

p3 <- m1_resids |>
  ggplot(aes(x = predicted_time_no_ai,
             y = .std.ls.resid)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Estimated time without AI (minutes)", y = "Residuals (noise term)")

p4 <- m1_resids |>
  ggplot(aes(sample = .std.ls.resid)) +
  geom_qq(size = 0.5) +
  geom_qq_line() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Theoretical normal quantiles",
       y = "Observed residual quantiles",
       title = "QQ plot of the residuals (noise term)")

p5 <- m1_ranef |>
  ggplot(aes(sample = .ranef.intercept)) +
  geom_qq(size = 0.5) +
  geom_qq_line() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Theoretical normal quantiles",
       y = "Observed random effect quantiles",
       title = "QQ plot of the random intercepts")

p6 <- m1_ranef |>
  ggplot(aes(sample = .ranef.ai_treatment)) +
  geom_qq(size = 0.5) +
  geom_qq_line() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Theoretical normal quantiles",
       y = "Observed random effect quantiles",
       title = "QQ plot of the random slopes")

(p1 + p2 + p3)/(p4 + p5 + p6)
```

```{r, echo=F, message=F, warning=F, fig.width=10, fig.height =7}
lmm_resids <- function(f){
  data.frame(resid = hlm_resid(f, standardize=T)$.std.ls.resid,
             dev_id = as.factor(model.frame(f)$dev_id))
}

regressinator::model_lineup(m1, lmm_resids, 20) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = dev_id, y = resid)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size=0.5) +
  facet_wrap(vars(.sample)) +
  labs(x = "Developer ID", 
       y = "Residuals (noise term)",
       title = "Lineup plot") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_blank()) +
  theme(
  strip.background = element_blank(),
  strip.text.x = element_blank()
)
```

# Model 2

$$\log(\text{T}_{ij}) = (\beta_0 + a_i) + (\beta_1 + b_i) \text{AI}_{ij} + \beta_2 \log(\text{EstTimeNoAI}_{ij}) + \varepsilon_{ij}$$

$$\varepsilon_{ij} \sim N(0, \sigma_{\varepsilon}^2) \hspace{0.5cm} \begin{bmatrix} a_i \\ b_i \end{bmatrix} \sim N\left( \begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ 0 \end{bmatrix}, \begin{bmatrix} \sigma_a^2 & \rho_{ab} \sigma_a \sigma_b \\ \rho_{ab} \sigma_a \sigma_b & \sigma_b^2 \end{bmatrix} \right)$$

where $\text{T}_{ij}$ is the initial completion time for developer $i$ on task $j$, $\text{AI}_{ij}$ is 1 if AI use was allowed on the task, and $\text{EstTimeNoAI}_{ij}$ is the developer's guess for the time it would take to complete the task without AI (the guesses were made before being assigned the tasks).

```{r, include=F}
metr_ai <- metr_ai |>
  mutate(log_implementation = log(initial_implementation_time),
         log_predicted_no_ai = log(predicted_time_no_ai))

m1 <- lmer(log_implementation ~ 
             ai_treatment + log_predicted_no_ai +
             (ai_treatment|dev_id), data = metr_ai)
```


```{r, eval=F}
m2 <- lmer(log(initial_implementation_time) ~ 
             ai_treatment + log(predicted_time_no_ai) +
             (ai_treatment|dev_id), data = metr_ai)

summary(m2)
```

```
Random effects:
 Groups   Name         Variance Std.Dev. Corr 
 dev_id   (Intercept)  0.07439  0.2727        
          ai_treatment 0.03426  0.1851   -0.57
 Residual              0.35623  0.5969        
Number of obs: 246, groups:  dev_id, 16

Fixed effects:
                     Estimate Std. Error t value
(Intercept)          -0.17707    0.28860  -0.614
ai_treatment          0.15577    0.09261   1.682
log(predicted_no_ai)  0.97549    0.06155  15.849
```

p4 <- m1_resids |>

  geom_qq_line() +
  theme_bw() +

p5 <- m1_ranef |>
